name: The Clarity
subtitle: Focus Bracelet · Clear Quartz
promise: Clear quartz on its own: the blank page of the crystal world.
body: Eight-millimetre clear quartz, transparent with faint icy fractures, strung without any metal. Traditionally worn to amplify whatever intention you set and to keep the mind clear. Real stock from the studio, and once these are gone we will not restring them.
seoDescription: Clear quartz bracelet, traditionally worn for clarity and intention. Last pieces, hand-strung in Dubai, next-day delivery across the UAE.
